units.source_text: 他撑起身子，皮肤上受了风。

en.t: He propped himself up, and the wind struck his skin.

units.source_text: 翻身的时候，脸上盖着的手巾险些掉在地上，耳朵根、鼻子的两侧，嘴角都粘着沙子，厚得都能刮下来。

en.t: When he turned over, the towel covering his face almost fell to the ground; sand clung to the roots of his ears, both sides of his nose, and the corners of his mouth, thick enough to be scraped off.

units.source_text: 他搽好了眼药，用手巾的一角捂着，一定要如此重复好几次，眼睛才能像平时一样地睁开。

en.t: After putting in the eye medicine, he pressed the corner of the towel against his eyes; he had to repeat this several times before they would open as usual.

units.source_text: 然而，这眼药再过两三天也将要告罄。

en.t: But in another two or three days, this eye medicine would be used up as well.

units.source_text: 单为这事，也该尽早地分出个青红皂白来。

en.t: For this reason alone, he needed to settle the matter as soon as possible.

units.source_text: 他像穿了件铁衣服，睡在磁石做的床上，身体十分沉重。

en.t: His body felt terribly heavy, as if he were wearing iron clothes and lying on a bed made of magnets.

units.source_text: 他费了好些功夫，才把焦距对准，借着门口射进来的微弱光线，把视线移到死苍蝇脚似的铅字上。

en.t: It took him quite some effort to bring his eyes into focus; by the faint light coming in through the doorway, he shifted his gaze to the type, which looked like the legs of dead flies.
